thread:
jules: quick heads-up — new onboarding ticket: user couldn't get the JS SDK to work because of import/require confusion and edge runtime errors.

maria: what errors did they see?

jules: two variants: in a CJS project `TypeError: require(...).default is not a constructor`. in a Vercel Edge deploy `ReferenceError: process is not defined` after bundling.

hao: sounds like they used `require('redwood-inference')` in a project expecting CommonJS and our published entry is ESM-first. we do have a CJS compat at `/cjs` and an ESM `/edge`.

maria: docs only show `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference'` atm. that's confusing. we should add a tiny matrix at the top of quickstart: runtime -> entrypoint -> snippet.

docs-eng: agreed. proposed copy: "Node (ESM/bundlers): `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference'`. Node (CommonJS): `const { Client } = require('redwood-inference/cjs')`. Edge runtimes: `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference/edge'` (ESM only)."

jules: also call out exported symbols explicitly: we export named symbols (Client, utils). there is no default export — don't `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'`.

hao: add a short TS note: ESM users can `import type { ClientOptions } from 'redwood-inference'`. CJS + TS users should use JSDoc typedefs: `/** @type {import('redwood-inference').ClientOptions} */`

maria: include a quick diagnostic command in the FAQ: `node -e "console.log(require('redwood-inference/cjs'))"` which should print something like `{ Client: [Function: Client], version: 'x.y.z' }`. that helped the user debug.

docs-eng: will add code snippets for both styles, a one-line edge gotcha about `global/process/fs`, and a small FAQ "Why does require(...) return {} or undefined?" with checks for Node version and package.json exports.

support-bot: Created issue RW-DX-1203: "docs(js): clarify ESM/CJS/edge import patterns and add cjs smoke test" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1203

h ao: can someone add a tiny sample-app smoke test that runs the CJS example in CI? `node ci/cjs-smoke.js` that asserts `typeof Client === 'function'`.

maria: i'll add the docs PR and update the quickstart; jules can add the sample-app test and ping me. after that we'll update the onboarding checklist: "ask if they're using import or require (ESM vs CJS vs Edge)".

jules: will do. small docs + smoke test should cut these tickets down a lot :rocket:
